scope.description: Disjoint substantive audit of 200 previously unreviewed frozen families across 19 stable whole files.
scope.selection: Subtract all seven prior ledgers and whole mutation-helper file; exclude drifted native-eval files owned elsewhere.
scope.not_a_claim: Unit/local fixture evidence is not product, provider, live agent, semantic judge, or full Layer 4 qualification.

counting_model.house_counts: runtime output only, not family counts

source_files.simulation_boundary: synthetic observations/judge replies; no live semantic sensitivity
local fixtures/subprocess controls; no live roadmap

findings.finding: All 200 stable families have concrete assertion routes and passing focused execution.
Controlled evidence does not establish live/product/provider qualification.
No selected stale-hash failure; excluded files remain unassessed.
No cross-ledger integrity gate checks unique IDs, frozen membership, and hashes.
findings.action: Consider separate read-only ledger validator; no family replacement.

findings.finding: Combined injection run found six faults then had a namespace setup error; corrected isolated spec-index rerun found the seventh.
findings.action: Do not classify setup error as product failure.
